verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਣੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g mil dhutar tarane ||12||

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation meeting which the ardous world-ocean is crossed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਦੇ ਅਸਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜ ਕਰਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: audhe asat vich raaj kar chakravarat ghanere|

en.bdb: Many such kings are there whose kingdom extends from the point of sunrise to the point of sunset.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਲੈ ਦਰਬ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਿ ਚੰਗੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: arab kharab lai dharab nidh ras bhog cha(n)gere|

en.bdb: They have wealth worth billions and choice luxuries to enjoy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਘੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: narapat surapat chhatrapat haumai vich ghere|

en.bdb: All these kings of mortals and gods are engrossed in their ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕਹੁਂ ਚੜੑਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਵਸੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: siv lokahu(n) chaR(h)h braham lok baiku(n)Th vasere|

en.bdb: Rising from the abode of Siva they attain the abode of Brahma and Vaikunth, the heavens;

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣਾ ਹੋਹਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: chir jeevan bahu ha(n)ddanaa hoh vadde vaddere|

en.bdb: Many other long-lived have also flourished,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਇ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal agam hai hui bhale bhalere ||13||

en.bdb: But the pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is unapproachable and better than the best one.
